agree.reason: The letter gives specific, checkable details (the solo 3 a.m. shift, nine early mastitis cases, two missed shifts in three years), so a skimming reader would probably rate Tomás above the general pool, though the closing about what the industry needs is generic.

honest.reason: Several claims go beyond the brief: 'on his own initiative', 'seriously ill', and 'clearly and confidently in spoken English' are not stated there, and calling the absence a 'family medical leave' hides that he gave only two days' notice.

works_the_facts.reason: The facts are repeated rather than worked: two missed shifts out of roughly 780 is better than 99.7% attendance, and three years of solo 3 a.m. milkings is hundreds of unsupervised shifts, but neither figure is calculated.

right_comparison.reason: Apart from 'one of the most dependable people on our team', Tomás is never compared with other workers or with a typical applicant, so the reader has no baseline for his record.

qualification.reason: A reference letter needs no conditional hedge, and the one weakness, his written English, is presented as a fact together with the remedy he is already taking.

objections.reason: The two likely concerns, his written English and a long absence, are both raised and answered briefly without adding doubts the reader would not otherwise have, though the night class is described only vaguely.

fit.reason: It is a one-page formal reference letter from the farm manager with the standard letter format and placeholders, as the brief asked.
